AFK captures are enabled by default: aft: AFK captures are enabled by default: after 5 minutes of inactivity, at most once every 4 hours, even in the pause menu or while Minecraft is in the background. Without a connected account, they stay in your local folder. With a connected account, they also upload to your private gallery. The “Auto photos” button in M turns them on or off; M → Settings → Captures → Auto captures adjusts the delays and capture radius (32 blocks by default). A previously saved disable preference is preserved.
AFK captures are enabled by default afte: AFK captures are enabled by default after 5 minutes of inactivity, at most once every 4 hours. Once your account is linked, they upload automatically to your private gallery. You can turn them off with “Auto photos” in M. Without a linked account, they stay on your computer.
Technical diagnostics in the mod are on: Technical diagnostics in the mod are on by default, but nothing is ever sent before you pair the game with your account. An explicit refusal is kept, even after pairing, disconnecting or changing API. Reports are sanitised: versions, the failed step and a short technical trace, without raw messages, full crash logs, URLs, local paths, credentials, coordinates, seeds, world, player or server names, or capture contents. The mod keeps at most eight pending reports, for at most seven days. Turning diagnostics off or changing account or API purges this queue; turning them off also asks the server to delete this device's reports, and if it cannot be reached, its retention applies. Turn them off in M → Settings → Privacy → Diagnostics.
